_how: Recommendations shown on the site, newest first. Paste LinkedIn recommendations here, and approved ones sent from the site form. Fields: name, role, relation (mgr | rep | team | co | diff | study | client | sub | learn | other), text (as written, any language), date, source (linkedin | site), optional url (their LinkedIn), photo, project.
